# Analysis of Flood Impact on Population and Development Indicators

## Loading packages

```{r}
# Function to check and install required packages
check_install_packages <- function(packages) {
    # Check if packages are installed
    missing_packages <- packages[!sapply(packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]

    # Install missing packages
    if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
        install.packages(missing_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
    }

    # Load all packages
    lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
}

# List of required packages
required_packages <- c("terra", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "viridis", "rasterVis", "tidyterra", "patchwork")

# Check and install required packages
check_install_packages(required_packages)

# Load all required packages
lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

## Data Loading

```{r}
# {r} code block for loading data
# Set the directory path
folder_path <- "C:/Users/Rik/OneDrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/World_Pop_development_indicators/UGA_Maternal_and_child_health"

# List all .tif files in the directory
tif_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# Load all raster layers  using the rast function
raster_data_all <- lapply(tif_files, rast)

# Load and handle the administrative boundary of Kampala
kampala_extent <- vect("C:/Users/Rik/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/vBorders/20240308161055/processed/20240308162043/vBorders_Processed.shp")

# Reproject the raster data to the same projection as the vector data
raster_data_all <- lapply(raster_data_all, project, crs(kampala_extent))

# Load all rasters as separate objects
UGA_ANC_MEAN <- raster_data_all[[1]]
UGA_ANC_SD <- raster_data_all[[2]]
UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN <- raster_data_all[[3]]
UGA_INSURANCE_SD <- raster_data_all[[4]]
UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN <- raster_data_all[[5]]
UGA_MALNUTRITION_SD <- raster_data_all[[6]]

UGA_PNC_SD <- raster_data_all[[8]]

UGA_TT_MEAN <- raster_data_all[[11]]
UGA_TT_SD <- raster_data_all[[12]]

# Crop the raster data to the extent of Kampala
UGA_ANC_MEAN <- crop(UGA_ANC_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_ANC_SD <- crop(UGA_ANC_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN <- crop(UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN, kampala_extent)

UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN <- crop(UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN, kampala_extent)

UGA_PNC_MEAN <- crop(UGA_PNC_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_PNC_SD <- crop(UGA_PNC_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_SBA_MEAN <- crop(UGA_SBA_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_SBA_SD <- crop(UGA_SBA_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_TT_MEAN <- crop(UGA_TT_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_TT_SD <- crop(UGA_TT_SD, kampala_extent)

# Mask the raster data to the extent of Kampala
UGA_ANC_MEAN <- mask(UGA_ANC_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_ANC_SD <- mask(UGA_ANC_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN <- mask(UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_INSURANCE_SD <- mask(UGA_INSURANCE_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN <- mask(UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_MALNUTRITION_SD <- mask(UGA_MALNUTRITION_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_PNC_MEAN <- mask(UGA_PNC_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_PNC_SD <- mask(UGA_PNC_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_SBA_MEAN <- mask(UGA_SBA_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_SBA_SD <- mask(UGA_SBA_SD, kampala_extent)
UGA_TT_MEAN <- mask(UGA_TT_MEAN, kampala_extent)
UGA_TT_SD <- mask(UGA_TT_SD, kampala_extent)

# Set the names of the raster layers
names(UGA_ANC_MEAN) <- "ANC - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months born to mothers who did not attend antenatal care (Mean)"
names(UGA_ANC_SD) <- "ANC - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months born to mothers who did not attend antenatal care (SD)"
names(UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN) <- "Insurance - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who had no health insurance (Mean)"
names(UGA_INSURANCE_SD) <- "Insurance - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who had no health insurance (SD)"
names(UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN) <- "Malnutrition - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who were underweight (Mean)"
names(UGA_MALNUTRITION_SD) <- "Malnutrition - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who were underweight (SD)"
names(UGA_PNC_MEAN) <- "PNC - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who did not receive (or recall) post-natal care within 2 months after birth (Mean)"
names(UGA_PNC_SD) <- "PNC - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who did not receive (or recall) post-natal care within 2 months after birth (SD)"
names(UGA_SBA_MEAN) <- "SBA - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who were not delivered by a skilled birth attendant (Mean)"
names(UGA_SBA_SD) <- "SBA - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who were not delivered by a skilled birth attendant (SD)"
names(UGA_TT_MEAN) <- "TT - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who had no tetanus toxoid injections before birth (Mean)"
names(UGA_TT_SD) <- "TT - Proportion of children aged 12 to 23 months who had no tetanus toxoid injections before birth (SD)"

# Create a list of the mean and SD rasters
raster_data_mean <- c(UGA_ANC_MEAN, UGA_INSURANCE_MEAN, UGA_MALNUTRITION_MEAN, UGA_PNC_MEAN, UGA_SBA_MEAN, UGA_TT_MEAN)
raster_data_sd <- c(UGA_ANC_SD, UGA_INSURANCE_SD, UGA_MALNUTRITION_SD, UGA_PNC_SD, UGA_SBA_SD, UGA_TT_SD)
raster_data_all <- c(raster_data_mean, raster_data_sd)
```

## Plotting

```{r}
# {r} code block for plotting
# Function to create a ggplot for each raster with an individual legend
create_plot <- function(raster_layer, title) {
    # Insert a line break specifically after 'months'
    formatted_title <- gsub("months", "months\n", title, fixed = TRUE)

    p <- gplot(raster_layer) +
        geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") + # Using Viridis color scale, change as needed
        labs(title = formatted_title, fill = "Value") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
            legend.position = "right", # Adjust legend position as needed
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), # Center the title horizontally
            plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines")
        ) # Adjust margins around the plots
    return(p)
}

# Create a list of plots
plots_mean <- lapply(raster_data_mean, function(x) create_plot(x, names(x)))
plots_sd <- lapply(raster_data_sd, function(x) create_plot(x, names(x)))
plots_all <- lapply(raster_data_all, function(x) create_plot(x, names(x)))

# Use patchwork to combine and arrange all plots
plot_layout_mean <- wrap_plots(plots_mean, ncol = 2) # Adjust the number of columns as needed
plot_layout_sd <- wrap_plots(plots_sd, ncol = 2) # Adjust the number of columns as needed
plot_layout_all <- wrap_plots(plots_all, ncol = 2) # Adjust the number of columns as needed

print(plot_layout_mean)
print(plot_layout_sd)
print(plot_layout_all)
```
